items.q: also her mother, my grandmother Mrs.(Rouser)- Anna Jane(Rouser) rather

ctx.x: and so they decided to go and move to Philadelphia, also her mother, my grandmother Mrs.(Rouser)- Anna Jane(Rouser) rather - and her mother was also there, the Parkers, and her father, in Pittsburgh, so I think they decided to go there to be with the family.
So you're maybe roughly 4 years old when you get to Pittsburgh?
